collection.title: Citroen Picasso C4 Picasso 2013 to 2016 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Citroen Picasso C4 Picasso 2013 - 2016 model requires a 32" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 30" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Push Button arm attachment. We also have rear blade for this C4 Picasso, simply click on the Rear Blades tab below.
